scope: RAM/Node heap tuning only from measured baselines — no blanket heap increase.

contracts.noBlindIncrease: Production runtime must not set arbitrary --max-old-space-size/NODE_OPTIONS without a measured requirement and documented rollback rationale.
contracts.docs: Decision is derived from Stage 46-51 runtime, leak, load and >=2h soak evidence.
contracts.failClosed: A future explicit heap override requires new measured evidence and therefore a fresh Stage-52 review/gate.

decision: No production heap flag change. Retain the Node.js/V8 default heap policy because measured production-runtime evidence shows healthy GC recovery, bounded heap usage and no sustained heap growth under the Stage-51 two-hour load.

productionRuntimeInspection.reason: No measured memory-pressure failure, OOM, sustained heap growth or event-loop degradation justifies constraining or increasing V8 old-space at this point.
